records.literal_gloss: And consulted David with [the] commanders of the thousands and the hundreds, with every leader.

en.L: And David consulted with the commanders of the thousands and of the hundreds, with every ruler.
en.B: David consulted with the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, with every one of the leaders.
en.R: David asked for the advice of the army commanders, the officers over units of a thousand and of a hundred, and of all the leaders.

es.B: David consultó con los jefes de millares y de centenas, con cada uno de los líderes.
es.R: David pidió consejo a los comandantes del ejército, los oficiales sobre unidades de mil y de cien, y a todos los líderes.

fr.L: Et David tint conseil avec les chefs de milliers et de centaines, avec tous les princes.
fr.B: David tint conseil avec les chefs de milliers et de centaines, avec chacun des responsables.
fr.R: David a demandé l’avis des chefs de l’armée, des officiers qui commandaient mille hommes ou cent hommes, et de tous les responsables.

sw.L: Daudi akashauriana na makamanda wa maelfu na wa mamia, pamoja na kila kiongozi.
sw.B: Daudi alishauriana na makamanda wa maelfu na wa mamia, pamoja na kila mmoja wa viongozi.
sw.R: Daudi aliomba shauri kwa makamanda wa jeshi, yaani maafisa wa vikosi vya watu elfu na vya watu mia, na kwa viongozi wote.

vi.L: Đa-vít bàn bạc với các quan chỉ huy ngàn quân và trăm quân, với mọi người lãnh đạo.
vi.B: Đa-vít bàn bạc với các quan chỉ huy ngàn quân và trăm quân, cùng với tất cả các nhà lãnh đạo.
vi.R: Đa-vít hỏi ý kiến các quan chỉ huy trong quân đội, là những người chỉ huy các đơn vị một ngàn quân và một trăm quân, cùng với tất cả các nhà lãnh đạo.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 천부장들과 백부장들, 곧 모든 지도자와 의논했다.
ko.B: 다윗은 천부장들과 백부장들, 곧 모든 지도자와 의논했다.
ko.R: 다윗은 군대 지휘관들, 곧 천 명을 거느린 지휘관들과 백 명을 거느린 지휘관들과 모든 지도자에게 의견을 물었다.

pt.L: E Davi se aconselhou com os comandantes dos milhares e das centenas, com cada príncipe.
pt.B: Davi se aconselhou com os comandantes de mil e de cem, com cada um dos líderes.
pt.R: Davi pediu o conselho dos comandantes do exército, os oficiais que comandavam unidades de mil e de cem homens, e de todos os líderes.

am.L: ዳዊትም ከሺህና ከመቶ አለቆች ጋር፣ ከመሪም ሁሉ ጋር ተማከረ።

hi.L: और दाऊद ने हज़ारों और सैकड़ों के सेनानायकों से, हर प्रधान से सलाह की।
hi.B: दाऊद ने हज़ार-हज़ार और सौ-सौ के सेनानायकों से, सब अगुवों से सलाह की।

ru.L: И совещался Давид с тысяченачальниками и сотниками, со всяким начальником.
ru.B: Давид посовещался с тысяченачальниками и сотниками, со всеми начальниками.
ru.R: Давид спросил совета у военачальников, командовавших отрядами в тысячу и в сто воинов, и у всех вождей.

ja.L: そしてダビデは、千人隊の長たち、百人隊の長たち、すべての指導者と協議した。
ja.B: ダビデは、千人隊の長、百人隊の長、そしてすべての指導者たちと協議した。
ja.R: ダビデは、軍の隊長たち、つまり千人や百人の兵士を率いる隊長たちと、すべての指導者たちに意見を求めました。

uk.L: І порадився Давид з тисяцькими і сотниками, з кожним провідником.
uk.B: Давид порадився з тисяцькими й сотниками, з усіма провідниками.
uk.R: Давид попросив поради у військових начальників, тих, що командували загонами по тисячі й по сотні чоловіків, і в усіх провідників.

decisions.choice: verses 1-5 are found only in Chronicles; verses 6-14 retell 2 Samuel 6:2-11
decisions.reason: Chronicles begins the story of the ark with David taking counsel with the leaders and the whole assembly (verses 1-4), which 2 Samuel does not tell; there David simply gathers chosen men (2 Samuel 6:1). From verse 6 the story follows 2 Samuel 6:2-11 closely. Chronicles also places it differently: here it comes straight after David is made king and takes Jerusalem (chapters 11-12), and David's house, family and wars against the Philistines follow in chapter 14, while 2 Samuel tells those first (2 Samuel 5:11-25).

decisions.choice: consulted: took counsel, talked the plan over
decisions.reason: The verb means to take counsel or ask for advice. David does not act alone: he puts the plan to his officers and then to the whole assembly (verses 2-4).

decisions.choice: commanders of thousands and of hundreds: officers over army units
decisions.reason: These were the officers over the larger and smaller units of the army (1 Samuel 22:7; 2 Samuel 18:1). On the size of a "thousand" see the note at Numbers 1:21.

decisions.choice: with every leader: and with all the leaders
decisions.reason: The small word that joins this phrase may sum up the officers just named ("that is, with every leader") or add a further group ("and with every leader"). The word for "leader" is used of the ruler God appoints over his people (11:2), and here of leaders in general. Either way David consults everyone in authority.

decisions.choice: the army commanders, the officers over units of a thousand and of a hundred
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly who the commanders of thousands and of hundreds were, and "asked for the advice of" for "consulted with".

decisions.choice: ruler (Literal); leaders (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "ruler" for this word throughout these books (11:2). Here it names leaders in general, not a king, so Balanced and Readable say "leaders", as at 12:28.

decisions.choice: "les princes" (L); "les responsables" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Chefs" already renders the army commanders in this verse; the general word for leader takes a different French word so the two groups stay apart, as the English "ruler" / "leaders".

decisions.choice: "지도자" at every level
decisions.reason: The Samuel note's word for *nagid*, which here names leaders in general; Korean "지도자" already serves both senses, so no level needs to change it.

decisions.choice: príncipe (L); líderes (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "príncipe" for this title, as in 11:2 and 12:28; here it names leaders in general, so Balanced and Readable say "líderes", as the English does.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of 1 Chronicles 13.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Amharic (docs/amharic-style.md section 7).

decisions.choice: "የሺህና የመቶ አለቆች" for the commanders of thousands and hundreds (as 1 Samuel 8:12; 22:7); nagid as "መሪ"; verses 1-5 drafted from the Hebrew
decisions.reason: These verses have no parallel in 2 Samuel 6; the officers' titles keep the forms on main, and nagid keeps the settled "መሪ" at every level.

decisions.choice: verses 6-14 in the wording of 2 Samuel 6:2-11 where the Hebrew is the same
decisions.reason: Verses 1-5 are found only in Chronicles; verses 6-14 retell 2 Samuel 6:2-11. Where the Hebrew is the same, each level keeps the Hindi of 2 Samuel 6 (the ark, the cart, the instruments, Perez-uzzah, Obed-Edom); where it differs, so does the Hindi.

decisions.choice: sarei ha'alafim vehamme'ot "千人隊の長、百人隊の長" (L, B), "千人や百人の兵士を率いる隊長" (R), as 1SA-consistency; nagid "指導者" at every level.
decisions.reason: Book-wide titles.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד לְכֹ֣ל׀קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אִם־עֲלֵיכֶ֨ם ט֜וֹב וּמִן־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ נִפְרְצָה֙ נִשְׁלְחָ֞ה עַל־אַחֵ֣ינוּ הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֗ים בְּכֹל֙ אַרְצ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְעִמָּהֶ֛ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֖ם בְּעָרֵ֣י מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֑ם וְיִקָּבְצ֖וּ אֵלֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said David to all [the] assembly of Israel, If upon you [it is] good, and from Yahweh our God, let us break out, let us send to our brothers the remaining in all [the] lands of Israel, and with them the priests and the Levites in [the] cities of their pasturelands, and let them gather to us.

en.L: And David said to all the assembly of Israel, "If [it is] good to you, and [if it is] from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, let us spread out, let us send to our brothers who remain in all the lands of Israel, and with them the priests and the Levites in the cities of their pasturelands, and let them gather to us.
en.B: Then David said to the whole assembly of Israel, "If you approve, and if this comes from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, let us send out in every direction to our fellow Israelites who remain in all the territories of Israel, and to the priests and the Levites with them in the towns where they have their pasturelands, so that they may gather to us.
en.R: Then David said to the whole assembly of Israel, "If you think this is good, and if it is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God wants, let us send messengers everywhere. Let us send them to all our fellow Israelites who are left in every part of Israel, and to the priests and the Levites who live among them in their own towns and pasturelands. Let us ask them all to come and join us.

es.L: Y dijo David a toda la asamblea de Israel: «Si {{plural_you:les|os}} [parece] bien, y [si es] {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, extendámonos, enviemos a nuestros hermanos que quedan en todas las tierras de Israel, y con ellos a los sacerdotes y a los levitas en las ciudades de sus campos de pastoreo, y que se reúnan con nosotros.
es.B: Entonces David dijo a toda la asamblea de Israel: «Si {{plural_you:ustedes están|vosotros estáis}} de acuerdo, y si esto viene {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, enviemos mensajeros por todas partes a nuestros hermanos israelitas que quedan en todos los territorios de Israel, y a los sacerdotes y levitas que están con ellos en las ciudades donde tienen sus campos de pastoreo, para que se reúnan con nosotros.
es.R: Entonces David dijo a toda la asamblea de Israel: «Si {{plural_you:les|os}} parece bien, y si es lo que quiere {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, enviemos mensajeros por todas partes. Enviémoslos a todos nuestros hermanos israelitas que han quedado en cada región de Israel, y a los sacerdotes y levitas que viven entre ellos en sus propias ciudades y campos de pastoreo. Pidámosles a todos que vengan a unirse a nosotros.

fr.L: Et David dit à toute l’assemblée d’Israël : « Si [cela] vous [semble] bon, et [si cela vient] {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu, répandons-nous, envoyons [dire] à nos frères qui restent dans tous les territoires d’Israël, et avec eux aux prêtres et aux Lévites dans les villes de leurs pâturages, qu’ils se rassemblent auprès de nous.
fr.B: Puis David dit à toute l’assemblée d’Israël : « Si vous l’approuvez, et si cela vient {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu, envoyons des messagers de tous côtés à nos frères israélites qui sont restés dans tous les territoires d’Israël, ainsi qu’aux prêtres et aux Lévites qui sont avec eux dans les villes entourées de leurs pâturages, pour qu’ils se rassemblent auprès de nous.
fr.R: Puis David a dit à toute l’assemblée d’Israël : « Si vous trouvez que c’est une bonne idée, et si c’est ce que veut {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, envoyons des messagers partout. Envoyons-les à tous nos frères israélites qui sont restés dans toutes les régions d’Israël, et aussi aux prêtres et aux Lévites qui vivent parmi eux, dans leurs villes et leurs pâturages. Demandons-leur à tous de venir nous rejoindre.

sw.L: Daudi akaliambia kusanyiko lote la Israeli, "Ikiwa [ni] vema kwenu, na [ikiwa ni] kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, na tuenee, tutume kwa ndugu zetu waliobaki katika nchi zote za Israeli, na pamoja nao makuhani na Walawi katika miji yao yenye malisho, ili wakusanyike kwetu.
sw.B: Kisha Daudi akaliambia kusanyiko lote la Israeli, "Kama mnakubali, na kama jambo hili linatoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, na tutume wajumbe pande zote kwa ndugu zetu Waisraeli waliobaki katika nchi zote za Israeli, na kwa makuhani na Walawi walio pamoja nao katika miji yao yenye malisho, ili wakusanyike kwetu.
sw.R: Kisha Daudi akaliambia kusanyiko lote la Israeli, "Kama mnaona jambo hili ni jema, na kama ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu analotaka, na tutume wajumbe kila mahali. Tuwatume kwa ndugu zetu wote Waisraeli waliobaki katika kila sehemu ya Israeli, na kwa makuhani na Walawi wanaoishi miongoni mwao katika miji yao na malisho yao. Tuwaombe wote waje kujiunga nasi.

vi.L: Đa-vít nói với toàn thể hội chúng Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Nếu anh em thấy [là] tốt, và [nếu việc này] đến từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, chúng ta hãy lan ra, hãy sai người đến cùng anh em chúng ta còn lại trong khắp các miền đất Y-sơ-ra-ên, và cùng với họ, các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi trong các thành có đồng cỏ của họ, để họ tụ họp lại với chúng ta.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Đa-vít nói với toàn thể hội chúng Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Nếu anh em đồng ý, và nếu việc này đến từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, chúng ta hãy sai người đi khắp nơi đến cùng anh em đồng bào còn lại trong mọi miền đất Y-sơ-ra-ên, và đến cùng các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi sống giữa họ trong các thành có đồng cỏ, để họ tụ họp lại với chúng ta.
vi.R: Bấy giờ Đa-vít nói với toàn thể hội chúng Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Nếu anh em thấy việc này là tốt, và nếu đó là điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta muốn, chúng ta hãy sai người đi khắp nơi. Hãy sai họ đến cùng tất cả đồng bào chúng ta còn ở lại trong mọi miền Y-sơ-ra-ên, và đến cùng các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi sống giữa họ trong các thành và đồng cỏ của mình. Hãy mời tất cả họ đến cùng với chúng ta.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 이스라엘의 온 회중에게 말했다. "만일 [이것이] 여러분에게 좋고, 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로부터 [온 것이라면], 우리가 널리 퍼져 이스라엘 모든 땅에 남아 있는 우리 형제들에게, 그리고 그들과 함께 목초지가 딸린 성읍들에 있는 제사장들과 레위인들에게 보내어 그들이 우리에게 모이게 합시다.
ko.B: 그리고 다윗이 이스라엘의 온 회중에게 말했다. "여러분이 좋게 여기고, 이것이 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로부터 온 것이라면, 이스라엘 모든 지역에 남아 있는 우리 동포들과, 그들과 함께 목초지가 딸린 성읍들에 사는 제사장들과 레위인들에게 사방으로 사람을 보내어, 그들이 우리에게 모이게 합시다.
ko.R: 그리고 다윗이 이스라엘의 온 회중에게 말했다. "여러분이 이것을 좋게 여기고, 이것이 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 원하시는 일이라면, 사방으로 사람들을 보냅시다. 이스라엘 곳곳에 남아 있는 우리 동포들에게 사람들을 보냅시다. 그들 가운데서 자기 성읍과 목초지에 사는 제사장들과 레위인들에게도 보냅시다. 그들 모두에게 와서 우리와 함께하자고 합시다.

pt.L: E Davi disse a toda a assembleia de Israel: "Se [isto parece] bom a vocês, e [se vem] {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, nosso Deus, espalhemo-nos, mandemos [mensageiros] aos nossos irmãos que restam em todas as terras de Israel, e com eles aos sacerdotes e aos levitas nas cidades das suas pastagens, para que se reúnam conosco.
pt.B: Então Davi disse a toda a assembleia de Israel: "Se vocês estiverem de acordo, e se isto vem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o nosso Deus, mandemos mensageiros em todas as direções aos nossos compatriotas israelitas que ficaram em todos os territórios de Israel, e também aos sacerdotes e aos levitas que estão com eles nas cidades onde têm as suas pastagens, para que se reúnam conosco.
pt.R: Então Davi disse a toda a assembleia de Israel: "Se vocês acham que isto é bom, e se é isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus, quer, vamos mandar mensageiros para todos os lados. Vamos mandá-los a todos os nossos compatriotas israelitas que ficaram em todas as partes de Israel, e aos sacerdotes e aos levitas que moram entre eles nas suas cidades e pastagens. Vamos pedir que todos venham se juntar a nós.

decisions.choice: two conditions: the assembly's approval and the LORD's will
decisions.reason: David makes the plan depend on two things: that the assembly agrees, and that it comes from the LORD. The second clause has no verb; "from the LORD our God" means that the plan has his approval. The assembly gives its answer in verse 4.

decisions.choice: let us break out, let us send: let us send out far and wide
decisions.reason: The first verb means "break out, spread out" and is not joined to another verb this way anywhere else. Together the two seem to mean sending out in every direction, without holding back. Others take it as "let us send quickly", or read the first word slightly differently. The same verb "break out" returns when the LORD breaks out against Uzzah (verse 11; 15:13).

decisions.choice: our brothers who remain in all the lands of Israel: the rest of the people in every tribe's territory
decisions.reason: "Brothers" here means fellow members of the people of Israel (Deuteronomy 17:15). "Who remain" most likely means those still at home in their own territories, not present at the meeting; it may also recall that the people had been left few and scattered after Saul's defeat (10:7). "The lands of Israel" are the territories of the tribes.

decisions.choice: the priests and the Levites in the towns with pasturelands
decisions.reason: The Levites had no tribal territory of their own but were given towns with grazing land around them among the other tribes (Numbers 35:1-8; Joshua 21; 1 Chronicles 6:39-66). David calls them too because the ark was in their charge (15:2).

decisions.choice: our fellow Israelites
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "fellow Israelites" for "brothers", the members of the nation, so that the word is not taken to mean brothers by birth.

decisions.choice: let us send messengers everywhere ... Let us ask them all to come and join us
decisions.reason: Readable splits the long sentence into three, says who is sent, and turns "and let them gather to us" into a request to come.

decisions.choice: plural_you: les / os; ustedes están / vosotros estáis
decisions.reason: David speaks to the whole assembly, so the "you" is plural and takes the setting.

decisions.choice: na tuenee, tutume
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "let us break out, let us send" means sending out far and wide; Literal says "na tuenee" (let us spread out), and Balanced and Readable say plainly that messengers are sent everywhere.

decisions.choice: David says "anh em" to the assembly and "chúng ta" for all
decisions.reason: The king speaks to the whole assembly as one of them, joining them with "chúng ta"; "các ngươi" would make it a command, which the conditions of the verse rule out.

decisions.choice: David speaks to the assembly in 합쇼체 with "여러분"
decisions.reason: The king puts a plan to the whole assembly and asks for its consent, so he speaks to it respectfully, as a king addressing his people in council.

decisions.choice: vocês (David to the assembly); os nossos irmãos (L); os nossos compatriotas israelitas (B, R)
decisions.reason: David, the king, speaks to the assembly with "vocês". "Irmãos" at Literal means fellow members of the people (m3); Balanced and Readable say "compatriotas israelitas", as the English says "fellow Israelites", so that it is not read as brothers by birth. The levitical towns and their "pastagens" keep the words of Joshua 21:2 in Portuguese (m4).

decisions.choice: the assembly (qahal) as "ጉባኤ"; "the LORD our God" as "አምላካችን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}" with the prefix on both words ("ከአምላካችን {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}}"); "ወንድሞቻችን" (L), "ወገኖቻችን" (B, R); pasturelands "የግጦሽ መሬት", as Joshua 21
decisions.reason: Settled terms for Chronicles and the Pentateuch; Balanced and Readable say "fellow Israelites" as the English does, Literal keeps "brothers".

decisions.choice: David says "तुम" to the assembly
decisions.reason: The king speaks to his own people as their leader, so the assembly is "तुम", as a king addresses his subjects in 2 Samuel; "हम" includes him with them in the plan.

decisions.choice: "собрание"
decisions.reason: The assembly (qahal) is "собрание", as the Pentateuch note settles; David speaks to the whole gathering, so he says вы.

decisions.choice: qahal "集会" (L, B, R); achenu "わたしたちの兄弟たち" (L), "同胞" (B), "仲間のイスラエル人" (R), with no gender span, as the English.
decisions.reason: The 1 Samuel-Judges word for the assembly; the king speaks to it plainly (あなたがた L, B; あなたたち R).

decisions.choice: "зібрання" for the assembly (qahal)
decisions.reason: The shared note keeps "зібрання" for qahal and "громада" for ʿedah; Chronicles speaks often of the whole qahal of Israel.

decisions.choice: bring back: bring around to where we are
decisions.reason: The verb means "turn around" or "bring round". The ark had stayed in Kiriath-jearim, away from the people's life and worship, since the Philistines sent it back (1 Samuel 6:21-7:2). David proposes to bring it back among the people.

decisions.choice: seek it: the ark
decisions.reason: The ending on the verb can mean "it" or "him". The nearest noun is "the ark of our God", so it is read as "it": to come to the ark to worship and to ask God's guidance there, which Saul did only once (1 Samuel 14:18). Read as "him", the words would echo 10:13-14, where Saul died because he did not seek the LORD. The sense is close either way, since to seek the ark was to seek the God whose presence it marked.

decisions.choice: we did not seek: a key word in Chronicles
decisions.reason: To "seek" God means to turn to him in worship and trust, and Chronicles uses the word often (10:13-14; 16:10-11; 22:19; 28:9). David says "we": the neglect was the people's, not Saul's alone. When the ark is finally brought up, David says the first attempt failed because "we did not seek him in the proper way" (15:13).

decisions.choice: While Saul was king
decisions.reason: Readable says "while Saul was king" for "in the days of Saul" and puts it first.

decisions.choice: buscar (no la buscamos)
decisions.reason: "Seek" is a key word of Chronicles for turning to God; Spanish keeps the one verb "buscar" at every level so the theme can be followed.

decisions.choice: "nous ne nous en sommes pas occupés"
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "seeking" the ark meant, turning to it for worship and guidance; French "rechercher" alone could sound like looking for something lost.

decisions.choice: hatukulitafuta
decisions.reason: "Seek" is a key word of Chronicles for turning to God and his worship; the Swahili keeps the plain verb "kutafuta" at every level so that later uses can echo it.

decisions.choice: "tìm cầu"
decisions.reason: "Seek" is a key word of Chronicles for turning to God in worship; "tìm cầu" says seeking with prayer, not just looking for a lost thing, and is kept for this verb through the block.

decisions.choice: buscar (every level)
decisions.reason: "Buscar" keeps the Chronicler's key word for seeking God (m3), the same verb as 10:13-14, at every level; "a" refers to the ark, as m2 reads it.

decisions.choice: "seek" (darash) as "ፈለገ" at every level
decisions.reason: "Seeking" God is a key word in Chronicles (compare 10:13-14); keeping one verb lets the reader hear it each time it comes back.

decisions.choice: "खोज करना"
decisions.reason: Seeking is a key word in Chronicles. The Hindi keeps "खोज करना" at every level, as in 10:13-14, so that the reader hears the link with Saul, who did not seek the LORD.

decisions.choice: darash "求める" at every level, as in 10:13-14.
decisions.reason: A key word of Chronicles: Saul "did not seek" the LORD, and Israel did not seek the ark.

decisions.choice: Shihor of Egypt: the southern edge of the land
decisions.reason: The name Shihor is used of a stream at Egypt's edge (Joshua 13:3) and of the Nile (Isaiah 23:3). Here it marks the southern limit of the land, on the border of Egypt, near what Numbers 34:5 calls the Brook of Egypt. Its exact place is not known.

decisions.choice: Lebo-hamath: the northern edge of the land
decisions.reason: Lebo-hamath, "the entrance of Hamath" or the town of Lebo on the way to Hamath, is the northern limit of the promised land (Numbers 34:8; Joshua 13:5).

decisions.choice: from Shihor to Lebo-hamath: all Israel, from one end of the land to the other
decisions.reason: The same two limits mark the whole land in Joshua 13:3-5, and Solomon's people come "from Lebo-hamath to the Brook of Egypt" when the temple is dedicated (1 Kings 8:65). The whole people, from south to north, takes part in bringing the ark.

decisions.choice: Kiriath-jearim: where the ark had stayed
decisions.reason: After the Philistines sent the ark back, it was taken to the house of Abinadab in Kiriath-jearim and stayed there for many years (1 Samuel 7:1-2).

decisions.choice: on the border of Egypt in the south; in the far north; They came
decisions.reason: Readable says where the two places lay, so that the reader sees that the whole land is meant, and begins a new sentence for the purpose.

decisions.choice: o Sior; Lebo-Hamate; Quiriate-Jearim

records.literal_gloss: And went up David and all Israel to Baalah, to Kiriath-jearim which [belongs] to Judah, to bring up from there [the] ark of the God, Yahweh, sitting [on] the cherubim, which is called [the] name.

en.L: And David and all Israel went up to Baalah, to Kiriath-jearim, which [belongs] to Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who sits [on] the cherubim, which is called [by the] name.
en.B: David and all Israel went up to Baalah, that is, Kiriath-jearim, which belongs to Judah, to bring the ark of God up from there, the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who sits enthroned on the cherubim, the ark which is called by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.
en.R: Then David and all Israel went up to Baalah, which is Kiriath-jearim in Judah. They went to bring the ark of God up from there. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} sits as king above the cherubim, the winged creatures on the lid of the ark, and the ark bears {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.

es.L: Y subió David con todo Israel a Baalá, a Quiriat-jearim, que [es] de Judá, para subir de allí el arca de Dios, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que se sienta [sobre] los querubines, que es llamada [por el] nombre.
es.B: David y todo Israel subieron a Baalá, es decir, Quiriat-jearim, que pertenece a Judá, para subir de allí el arca de Dios, el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que tiene su trono sobre los querubines, el arca que es llamada por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.
es.R: Entonces David y todo Israel subieron a Baalá, que es Quiriat-jearim, en Judá. Fueron para subir de allí el arca de Dios. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reina sentado sobre los querubines, los seres alados que están sobre la tapa del arca, y el arca lleva {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.

fr.L: Et David et tout Israël montèrent à Baala, à Qiryath-Yearim, qui [est] à Juda, pour faire monter de là l’arche de Dieu, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui siège [sur] les chérubins, qui est appelée [du] nom.
fr.B: David et tout Israël montèrent à Baala, c’est-à-dire Qiryath-Yearim, qui appartient à Juda, pour faire monter de là l’arche de Dieu, l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qui siège sur son trône au-dessus des chérubins, l’arche qui porte {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.
fr.R: Ensuite David et tout Israël sont montés à Baala, c’est-à-dire Qiryath-Yearim, en Juda. Ils sont allés faire monter de là l’arche de Dieu. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} siège comme roi au-dessus des chérubins, les êtres ailés qui sont sur le couvercle de l’arche, et l’arche porte {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.

sw.L: Daudi na Israeli wote wakapanda Baala, kwenda Kiriath-yearimu, ulio wa Yuda, ili kulipandisha kutoka huko sanduku la Mungu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aketiye [juu ya] makerubi, linaloitwa [kwa] jina.
sw.B: Daudi na Israeli wote walipanda Baala, yaani Kiriath-yearimu, ulio wa Yuda, ili kulipandisha kutoka huko sanduku la Mungu, sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anayeketi katika enzi juu ya makerubi, linaloitwa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.R: Kisha Daudi na Israeli wote walipanda Baala, yaani Kiriath-yearimu katika Yuda. Walikwenda kulipandisha sanduku la Mungu kutoka huko. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huketi kama mfalme juu ya makerubi, viumbe wenye mabawa walio juu ya kifuniko cha sanduku, nalo sanduku linaitwa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.

vi.L: Đa-vít và cả Y-sơ-ra-ên đi lên Ba-a-la, đến Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim, [thuộc] Giu-đa, để đem hòm của Đức Chúa Trời từ đó lên, [hòm của] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng ngự [trên] các chê-ru-bim, là hòm được gọi [bằng] danh.
vi.B: Đa-vít và cả Y-sơ-ra-ên đi lên Ba-a-la, tức là Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim thuộc Giu-đa, để rước hòm của Đức Chúa Trời từ đó lên, là hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng ngự trên các chê-ru-bim, hòm được gọi bằng danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Rồi Đa-vít và cả Y-sơ-ra-ên đi lên Ba-a-la, tức là Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim thuộc Giu-đa. Họ đi để rước hòm của Đức Chúa Trời từ đó lên. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngự như vua ở trên các chê-ru-bim, là những vật có cánh trên nắp hòm, và hòm ấy mang danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗과 온 이스라엘이 바알라, 곧 유다에 [속한] 기럇여아림으로 올라가, 거기에서 그룹들 [위에] 앉아 계시는 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 올려 오려고 했다. 그것은 그 이름으로 불린다.
ko.B: 다윗과 온 이스라엘은 유다에 속한 바알라, 곧 기럇여아림으로 올라가서, 거기에서 하나님의 궤를 올려 오려고 했다. 그 궤는 그룹들 위에 앉아 다스리시는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤이며, 그분의 이름으로 불리는 궤였다.
ko.R: 그때 다윗과 온 이스라엘은 유다에 있는 바알라, 곧 기럇여아림으로 올라갔다. 그들은 거기에서 하나님의 궤를 올려 오려고 갔다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그룹들 위에 왕으로 앉아 계신다. 그룹들은 궤 뚜껑 위에 있는 날개 달린 존재들이다. 그 궤에는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름이 붙어 있었다.

pt.L: E Davi e todo o Israel subiram a Baalá, a Quiriate-Jearim, que [pertence] a Judá, para fazer subir dali a arca de Deus, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que se assenta [sobre] os querubins, que é chamada [pelo] nome.
pt.B: Davi e todo o Israel subiram a Baalá, isto é, Quiriate-Jearim, que pertence a Judá, para levar dali para cima a arca de Deus, a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que está entronizado sobre os querubins, a arca que é chamada pelo {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome.
pt.R: Então Davi e todo o Israel subiram a Baalá, que é Quiriate-Jearim, em Judá. Foram para levar dali para cima a arca de Deus. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} se assenta como rei acima dos querubins, as criaturas com asas que ficavam sobre a tampa da arca, e a arca leva o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome.

am.L: ዳዊትና እስራኤል ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት፣ በኪሩቤል ላይ የሚቀመጠውን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}}፣ [በ]ስሙ የሚጠራውን [ታቦት] ከዚያ ያወጡ ዘንድ ወደ በኣላ፣ የይሁዳ ወደ ሆነችው ወደ ቂርያትይዓሪም ወጡ።
am.B: ዳዊትና እስራኤል ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ከዚያ ለማምጣት ወደ በኣላ፣ ማለትም የይሁዳ ወደ ሆነችው ወደ ቂርያትይዓሪም ወጡ፤ ይህ ታቦት በኪሩቤል ላይ በዙፋኑ የተቀመጠው {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ታቦት ሲሆን በስሙም የተጠራ ነው።
am.R: ከዚያም ዳዊትና እስራኤል ሁሉ በይሁዳ ወዳለችው ወደ በኣላ፣ ማለትም ወደ ቂርያትይዓሪም ወጡ። የሄዱትም የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ከዚያ ለማምጣት ነበር። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በታቦቱ መክደኛ ላይ ባሉት ክንፍ ባላቸው ፍጡራን፣ በኪሩቤል ላይ እንደ ንጉሥ ይቀመጣል፤ ታቦቱም በስሙ ይጠራል።

hi.L: और दाऊद और सारा इस्राएल बाला को, यहूदा के किर्यत-यारीम को, चढ़ गए, कि वहाँ से परमेश्वर का संदूक ऊपर ले आएँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का, जो करूबों पर विराजमान हैं, जो नाम से कहलाता है।
hi.B: दाऊद और सारा इस्राएल बाला को, अर्थात् यहूदा के किर्यत-यारीम को, चढ़ गए, कि वहाँ से परमेश्वर का संदूक ऊपर ले आएँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वह संदूक, जो करूबों पर सिंहासन पर विराजमान हैं, वह संदूक जो उनके नाम से कहलाता है।

ru.L: И поднялся Давид и весь Израиль в Ваалу, в Кирьят-Иарим, который у Иуды, чтобы поднять оттуда ковчег Бога, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, сидящего [на] херувимах, который наречён [этим] именем.
ru.B: Давид и весь Израиль поднялись в Ваалу, то есть в Кирьят-Иарим, который принадлежит Иуде, чтобы перенести оттуда ковчег Божий, ковчег {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, восседающего на херувимах, ковчег, который носит {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя.
ru.R: Тогда Давид и весь Израиль поднялись в Ваалу, то есть в Кирьят-Иарим в Иудее. Они пошли, чтобы принести оттуда ковчег Божий. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} восседает как царь над херувимами — крылатыми существами на крышке ковчега, и ковчег носит {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя.

ja.L: そしてダビデと全イスラエルは、バアラへ、ユダに属するキルヤト・エアリムへ上って行った。そこから神の箱、ケルビムの上に座しておられる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の[箱]、その名で呼ばれている[箱]を運び上げるためである。
ja.B: ダビデと全イスラエルは、バアラ、すなわちユダに属するキルヤト・エアリムに上って行った。そこから神の箱を運び上げるためである。それは、ケルビムの上に王として座しておられる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の箱であり、その名で呼ばれている箱である。
ja.R: ダビデとイスラエルの人々はみな、バアラ、つまりユダにあるキルヤト・エアリムに上って行きました。そこから神の箱を運び上げるためです。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ケルビムの上に王として座っておられます。ケルビムとは、箱のふたの上にある、翼のある生き物です。この箱には、その方の名がつけられています。

uk.L: І піднявся Давид і ввесь Ізраїль до Баали, до Кіріят-Єаріма, що [належить] Юді, щоб винести звідти ковчег Бога, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, що сидить [на] херувимах, що зветься [на] імʼя.
uk.B: Давид і ввесь Ізраїль піднялися до Баали, тобто Кіріят-Єаріма, що належить Юді, щоб винести звідти Божий ковчег, ковчег {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, що сидить на престолі над херувимами, ковчег, що зветься {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼям.
uk.R: Тоді Давид і ввесь Ізраїль піднялися до Баали, тобто Кіріят-Єаріма в Юді. Вони пішли, щоб винести звідти Божий ковчег. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сидить як цар над херувимами, крилатими істотами на віку ковчега, і ковчег носить {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя.

decisions.choice: Baalah, that is Kiriath-jearim, which belongs to Judah
decisions.reason: Baalah is an older name for Kiriath-jearim (Joshua 15:9; also called Kiriath-baal, Joshua 15:60). The town lay on Judah's northern border (Joshua 18:14). Chronicles gives both names so that the reader knows the place.

decisions.choice: the differences from 2 Samuel 6:2
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 6:2 says that David and "all the people who were with him" set out "from Baale-judah"; Chronicles says that David and "all Israel" went up "to Baalah, to Kiriath-jearim, which belongs to Judah", explaining the old name and making the town the goal of the journey (see the note at 2 Samuel 6:2 on "from" and "to"). The ark's title is also shorter: 2 Samuel has "the ark of God, which is called by the name, the name of the LORD of hosts, who sits on the cherubim over it"; Chronicles has "the ark of God, the LORD who sits on the cherubim, which is called by the name", without "of hosts" and "over it", with "name" once, and with the LORD's name straight after "God".

decisions.choice: which is called by the name: the ark, called by the LORD's name
alternatives: where his name is called on
decisions.reason: The last clause has no stated subject. It most likely refers to the ark, which is "called by the name" of the LORD, that is, belongs to him, as 2 Samuel 6:2 says more fully (Deuteronomy 28:10; Jeremiah 7:10-11). It can also be read of the LORD, "whose name is called on there". Either way the LORD's name is linked to the ark.

decisions.choice: sits: sits enthroned, reigns
decisions.reason: As in 1 Samuel 4:4 and 2 Samuel 6:2, the verb "sit" said of a king means to sit on a throne. The LORD is pictured as king seated above the cherubim on the ark's cover, with the ark as his footstool (28:2; Psalm 99:1).

decisions.choice: that is; by his name
decisions.reason: Balanced adds "that is" to show that Baalah and Kiriath-jearim are one town, and "his" to say whose name is meant (m3).

decisions.choice: sits as king above the cherubim, the winged creatures on the lid of the ark, and the ark bears his name
decisions.reason: Readable explains the cherubim in the words used at 2 Samuel 6:2 and says in a new sentence that the ark bears the LORD's name.

decisions.choice: que tiene su trono sobre los querubines (B); reina sentado sobre los querubines (R)
decisions.reason: The same wording as the Spanish of 2 Samuel 6:2, which this verse retells; "the LORD of hosts" of Samuel is simply "the LORD" here.

decisions.choice: aketiye [juu ya] makerubi (L); anayeketi katika enzi juu ya makerubi (B); huketi kama mfalme juu ya makerubi (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 2 Samuel 6:2 is kept at each level; Chronicles names the ark simply "called by the name", so Balanced and Readable supply "his name", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "하나님의 궤" for the ark of God, "주의 궤" for the ark of the LORD, as in 2 Samuel 6
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note; Chronicles often has "the ark of God" where 2 Samuel 6 has "the ark of the LORD", and the Korean follows each verse.

decisions.choice: Baalá; se assenta [sobre] os querubins (L); está entronizado sobre (B); se assenta como rei acima dos querubins (R)
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 6:2 in Portuguese, level by level ("Baalá", "fazer subir", "entronizado", Readable's explanation of the cherubim), with Chronicles' changes (m2): David and "todo o Israel" go up "a Baalá, a Quiriate-Jearim", and the ark is called by the name without "dos Exércitos". Balanced and Readable add "seu" with the deity_pronoun setting, as the English adds "his" (m3).

decisions.choice: drafted from the Chronicles Hebrew, keeping from 2 Samuel 6:2 "በኪሩቤል ላይ በዙፋኑ የተቀመጠው" (B) and the Readable gloss "በታቦቱ መክደኛ ላይ ባሉት ክንፍ ባላቸው ፍጡራን፣ በኪሩቤል ላይ እንደ ንጉሥ ይቀመጣል"
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 6:2 has "David and all the people with him" setting out "from Baale-judah" ("ከበኣሌ ይሁዳ") and "Yahweh of hosts"; Chronicles has "all Israel" going up "to Baalah, to Kiriath-jearim" and "Yahweh" without "of hosts". "Baalah" keeps the form of Joshua 15:9, which also says it is Kiriath-jearim.

decisions.choice: "उनके नाम", "उन्हीं का नाम", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi; the honorific plural "उनके", "विराजमान हैं" shows that the LORD is meant, as in 2 Samuel 6:2.

decisions.choice: on a new cart: carried by oxen instead of on men's shoulders
decisions.reason: A new cart, never used for ordinary work, was a mark of respect. But it was how the Philistines had sent the ark back (1 Samuel 6:7-8). The law gave the holy things to the Levites of Kohath to carry on their shoulders with poles (Exodus 25:14; Numbers 4:15; 7:9). When David tried again, the Levites carried the ark in that way (15:2, 15), and David said the first attempt failed because they had not sought the LORD in the proper way (15:13).

decisions.choice: the differences from 2 Samuel 6:3-4
decisions.reason: Chronicles tells this more briefly than 2 Samuel 6:3-4. It does not say that Abinadab's house was "on the hill" or that Uzzah and Ahio were "the sons of Abinadab", and it has neither the words that 2 Samuel 6:4 repeats from 6:3 nor "Ahio was walking before the ark". It says "driving the cart", where 2 Samuel says "the new cart". Chronicles writes Uzzah's name with a different last letter throughout; he is the same man.

decisions.choice: carried
decisions.reason: The verb means "made to ride". At 2 Samuel 6:3 Literal says "set ... on", because a second verb, "and carried it", follows there; here the one verb covers the whole journey from Abinadab's house, so Literal and Balanced say "carried". Readable keeps the wording of 2 Samuel 6:3.

decisions.choice: guiding the cart
decisions.reason: As at 2 Samuel 6:3: the men walked beside the oxen and steered them.

decisions.choice: celebrating: making merry with music and dance
decisions.reason: The verb means "laugh, play, make merry", as at 2 Samuel 6:5. It is used of dancing in celebration (1 Samuel 18:7; Jeremiah 31:4), and Michal sees David "dancing and celebrating" when the ark comes into the city (15:29).

decisions.choice: the differences from 2 Samuel 6:5
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 6:5 has "all the house of Israel" celebrating "before the LORD with all kinds of cypress wood"; Chronicles has "all Israel" celebrating "before God with all strength and with songs". In Hebrew the two readings share many letters, and one may have come from the other in copying (see the note at 2 Samuel 6:5). The list of instruments also differs: Chronicles has no rattles and adds trumpets.

decisions.choice: before God: in front of the ark, where God was present
decisions.reason: The ark marked the place of God's presence (verse 6), so to celebrate before the ark was to celebrate before God himself.

decisions.choice: lyres, harps, tambourines, cymbals and trumpets
decisions.reason: The lyre and the harp were stringed instruments, the lyre the smaller; the tambourine was a hand drum; cymbals were struck metal plates (see 2 Samuel 6:5). The trumpets were the metal trumpets blown by the priests (Numbers 10:2, 8; 1 Chronicles 15:24; 16:6).

decisions.choice: with all their might
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "their": it is the people's own strength that is meant. Readable adds "sang" and "played" to say what was done with the songs and instruments.

decisions.choice: vinubi, zeze, matari, matoazi, tarumbeta
decisions.reason: The instruments take the names used in the Swahili Psalms and 2 Samuel 6:5: "kinubi" for the lyre, "zeze" for the harp, "matari" for tambourines, "matoazi" for cymbals; the metal trumpets are "tarumbeta".

decisions.choice: "수금, 비파, 소고, 심벌즈, 나팔"
decisions.reason: The instrument names of 2 Samuel 6:5 in Korean; "나팔" is the priests' metal trumpet, kept apart from the ram's-horn "숫양 뿔 나팔".

decisions.choice: celebravam (L, B), faziam festa (R); com toda a força, com cânticos; trombetas
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 6:5 in Portuguese, changed where Chronicles changes it (m2): "todo o Israel", "diante de Deus", "com toda a força e com cânticos" for Samuel's cypress wood, and "trombetas", the priests' metal trumpets (m4), where Samuel has "chocalhos". The other instruments keep Samuel's words.

decisions.choice: 2 Samuel 6:5 with "በእግዚአብሔር ፊት" ("before God"), "በኃይል ሁሉ" ("with all strength") and "በዝማሬ" ("with songs") for "before Yahweh with all cypress wood"; lyres "በገና", harps "መሰንቆ", tambourines "ከበሮ", cymbals (metsiltayim) "ቃጭል", trumpets "መለከት"
decisions.reason: Chronicles reads "with all strength and with songs" where Samuel reads "with all cypress wood", has "God" for "Yahweh", has no rattles, and adds trumpets. The instruments keep the words of 2 Samuel 6:5, cymbals as Samuel's cymbals and trumpets as Numbers 10.

decisions.choice: kinnorot "竪琴" (L, B), "たて琴" (R); nevalim "琴"; tuppim "タンバリン"; metsiltayim "シンバル"; chatsotserot "ラッパ" (as 2KI 11:14); mesachaqim "喜び踊っていた" (L, B), "喜び祝っていました" (R), as 2 Samuel 6:5.
decisions.reason: Instrument names as 1-2 Samuel.

decisions.choice: "ліра", "арфа", "бубон", "кимвал", "сурма" for the instruments
decisions.reason: Plain modern names for the lyre, harp, tambourine, cymbals and trumpets; "цимбали" is a different Ukrainian instrument, so the Bible word "кимвали" is kept. Used through the book.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד־גֹּ֣רֶן כִּידֹ֑ן וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח עֻזָּ֜א אֶת־יָד֗וֹ לֶאֱחֹז֙ אֶת־הָ֣אָר֔וֹן כִּ֥י שָֽׁמְט֖וּ הַבָּקָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And they came to [the] threshing floor of Chidon, and put out Uzzah his hand to take hold of the ark, for stumbled the oxen.

en.L: And they came to the threshing floor of Chidon, and Uzzah put out his hand to take hold of the ark, for the oxen stumbled.
en.B: When they arrived at the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzzah put out his hand to take hold of the ark, for the oxen had stumbled.
en.R: When they reached the threshing floor of Chidon, the oxen stumbled. Uzzah reached out his hand to grab the ark and steady it.

es.L: Y llegaron a la era de Quidón, y Uza extendió su mano para sostener el arca, porque los bueyes tropezaron.
es.B: Cuando llegaron a la era de Quidón, Uza extendió la mano para sostener el arca, porque los bueyes habían tropezado.
es.R: Cuando llegaron a la era de Quidón, los bueyes tropezaron. Uza extendió la mano y agarró el arca para que no se cayera.

fr.L: Et ils arrivèrent à l’aire de Kidôn, et Ouzza étendit la main pour saisir l’arche, car les bœufs avaient bronché.
fr.B: Quand ils arrivèrent à l’aire de Kidôn, Ouzza tendit la main pour saisir l’arche, car les bœufs avaient trébuché.
fr.R: Quand ils sont arrivés à l’aire de Kidôn, les bœufs ont trébuché. Ouzza a tendu la main pour attraper l’arche et la retenir.

sw.L: Wakafika kwenye uwanja wa kupuria wa Kidoni, naye Uza akanyosha mkono wake kulishika sanduku, kwa maana ng'ombe walijikwaa.
sw.B: Walipofika kwenye uwanja wa kupuria wa Kidoni, Uza alinyosha mkono wake ili kulishika sanduku, kwa sababu ng'ombe walikuwa wamejikwaa.
sw.R: Walipofika kwenye uwanja wa kupuria wa Kidoni, ng'ombe walijikwaa. Uza akanyosha mkono wake akalishika sanduku ili lisianguke.

vi.L: Khi họ đến sân đập lúa Ki-đôn, U-xa đưa tay ra nắm lấy hòm, vì bò trượt chân.
vi.B: Khi họ đến sân đập lúa Ki-đôn, U-xa đưa tay ra nắm lấy hòm, vì bò bị trượt chân.
vi.R: Khi họ đến sân đập lúa Ki-đôn, bò trượt chân. U-xa đưa tay ra nắm lấy hòm để giữ cho vững.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 기돈의 타작마당에 이르렀을 때, 웃사가 궤를 붙잡으려고 손을 내밀었다. 소들이 비틀거렸기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그들이 기돈의 타작마당에 이르렀을 때, 웃사가 손을 내밀어 궤를 붙잡았다. 소들이 비틀거렸기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그들이 기돈의 타작마당에 이르렀을 때 소들이 비틀거렸다. 그러자 웃사가 손을 뻗어 궤를 붙잡아 흔들리지 않게 했다.

pt.L: E chegaram à eira de Quidom, e Uzá estendeu a sua mão para segurar a arca, porque os bois tropeçaram.
pt.B: Quando chegaram à eira de Quidom, Uzá estendeu a mão para segurar a arca, porque os bois tinham tropeçado.
pt.R: Quando chegaram à eira de Quidom, os bois tropeçaram. Uzá estendeu a mão para segurar a arca, para que ela não caísse.

am.L: ወደ ኪዶንም አውድማ መጡ፤ በሬዎቹም ተሰናክለው ነበርና ዖዛ ታቦቱን ይይዝ ዘንድ እጁን ዘረጋ።
am.B: ወደ ኪዶን አውድማ በደረሱ ጊዜ በሬዎቹ ተሰናክለው ስለ ነበር ዖዛ ታቦቱን ለመያዝ እጁን ዘረጋ።
am.R: ወደ ኪዶን አውድማ በደረሱ ጊዜ በሬዎቹ ተሰናከሉ። ዖዛም ታቦቱ እንዳይወድቅ እጁን ዘርግቶ ታቦቱን ያዘ።

hi.L: और जब वे कीदोन के खलिहान तक आए, तो उज्जा ने संदूक को थामने के लिए अपना हाथ बढ़ाया, क्योंकि बैलों ने ठोकर खाई।
hi.B: जब वे कीदोन के खलिहान पर पहुँचे, तो उज्जा ने संदूक को थामने के लिए अपना हाथ बढ़ाया, क्योंकि बैलों ने ठोकर खाई थी।
hi.R: जब वे कीदोन के खलिहान पर पहुँचे, तो बैलों ने ठोकर खाई। उज्जा ने संदूक को सँभालने के लिए हाथ बढ़ाकर उसे पकड़ लिया।

ru.L: И пришли они к гумну Хидона, и протянул Оза свою руку, чтобы ухватиться за ковчег, потому что волы споткнулись.
ru.B: Когда они дошли до гумна Хидона, Оза протянул руку, чтобы ухватиться за ковчег, потому что волы споткнулись.
ru.R: Когда они дошли до гумна Хидона, волы споткнулись. Оза протянул руку и схватился за ковчег, чтобы удержать его.

ja.L: そして彼らがキドンの打ち場まで来たとき、ウザは箱をつかもうとして手を伸ばした。牛がよろめいたからである。
ja.B: 一行がキドンの打ち場に来たとき、牛がよろめいたので、ウザは手を伸ばして箱を押さえようとした。
ja.R: 一行がキドンという所の、穀物を打つ場所まで来たとき、牛がよろめきました。ウザは手を伸ばして、箱をつかんで支えようとしました。

uk.L: І прийшли вони до току Кідона, і простяг Узза свою руку, щоб схопити ковчег, бо воли спіткнулися.
uk.B: Коли вони дійшли до току Кідона, Узза простяг руку, щоб підтримати ковчег, бо воли спіткнулися.
uk.R: Коли вони дійшли до току Кідона, воли спіткнулися. Узза простяг руку, щоб схопити ковчег і втримати його.

decisions.choice: the threshing floor of Chidon; put out his hand to take hold of the ark
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 6:6 calls the place "the threshing floor of Nacon". Whether these are two names for one place, or one name changed in copying, is not known. 2 Samuel also says only that Uzzah "sent to the ark of God and took hold of it"; Chronicles says "put out his hand to take hold of the ark". A threshing floor was a flat open space where grain was threshed.

decisions.choice: the oxen stumbled: the cart lurched
decisions.reason: As at 2 Samuel 6:6: the verb means "let drop" or "let loose", and probably says that the oxen stumbled or slipped, so that the ark was in danger of falling.

decisions.choice: the oxen stumbled; to grab the ark and steady it
decisions.reason: As at 2 Samuel 6:6, Readable tells the events in the order they happened and says why Uzzah took hold.

decisions.choice: a eira de Quidom; estendeu a sua mão
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 6:6 in Portuguese with Chronicles' differences (m1): the place is "Quidom", the Hebrew of Chronicles written as Portuguese spells it, as the English follows Chronicles' "Chidon" and not Samuel's "Nacom"; and Uzzah "estendeu a sua mão", so Literal needs no brackets.

decisions.choice: "ኪዶን" for the threshing floor of Chidon, where 2 Samuel 6:6 has "ናኮን"; "his hand" and "the ark" as Chronicles has them
decisions.reason: Chronicles names the threshing floor Chidon and says "Uzza put out his hand to take hold of the ark" where Samuel has "put out to the ark of God and took hold of it"; the rest keeps the Samuel wording.

decisions.choice: Chidon "キドン" (2 Samuel 6:6 has ナコン); goren "打ち場" (L, B), "穀物を打つ場所" (R).
decisions.reason: Chronicles names the threshing floor differently; the Japanese follows the Hebrew of each book.

source.text: וַיִּֽחַר־אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ בְּעֻזָּ֔א וַיַּכֵּ֕הוּ עַ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַ֥ח יָד֖וֹ עַל־הָאָר֑וֹן וַיָּ֥מָת שָׁ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And burned [the] anger of Yahweh against Uzzah, and he struck him because that he put out his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.

en.L: And the anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} burned against Uzzah, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} struck him because he put out his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.
en.B: Then the anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} blazed against Uzzah, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} struck him down because he had put out his hand to the ark. He died there before God.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} was very angry with Uzzah. He struck him down because Uzzah had put his hand on the ark, and Uzzah died there in front of God.

es.L: Y se encendió la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} contra Uza, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo hirió porque había extendido su mano sobre el arca; y murió allí delante de Dios.
es.B: Entonces la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} ardió contra Uza, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo hirió porque había extendido la mano hacia el arca. Murió allí delante de Dios.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se enojó mucho con Uza. Lo hirió porque Uza había puesto la mano sobre el arca, y Uza murió allí delante de Dios.

fr.L: Et la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} s’enflamma contre Ouzza, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le frappa parce qu’il avait étendu la main sur l’arche ; et il mourut là, devant Dieu.
fr.B: Alors la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} s’enflamma contre Ouzza, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le frappa parce qu’il avait porté la main sur l’arche. Il mourut là, devant Dieu.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est mis très en colère contre Ouzza. Il l’a frappé parce qu’Ouzza avait mis la main sur l’arche, et Ouzza est mort sur place, devant Dieu.

sw.L: Hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ikawaka juu ya Uza, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akampiga kwa sababu alinyosha mkono wake juu ya sanduku; naye akafa hapo mbele za Mungu.
sw.B: Ndipo hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ikawaka dhidi ya Uza, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akampiga kwa sababu alikuwa amenyosha mkono wake kwenye sanduku. Akafa hapo mbele za Mungu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimkasirikia Uza sana. Akampiga kwa sababu Uza alikuwa ameweka mkono wake juu ya sanduku, naye Uza akafa hapo mbele za Mungu.

vi.L: Cơn giận của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi phừng lên cùng U-xa, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đánh ông vì ông đã đưa tay ra trên hòm; và ông chết tại đó trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Bấy giờ cơn giận của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bừng lên cùng U-xa, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đánh chết ông vì ông đã đưa tay ra chạm vào hòm. Ông chết tại đó trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} rất giận U-xa. Ngài đánh ông vì U-xa đã đặt tay trên hòm, và U-xa chết tại đó trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 진노가 웃사에게 타올랐고, 그가 궤에 손을 내밀었기 때문에 그분께서 그를 치셨다. 그래서 그가 거기 하나님 앞에서 죽었다.
ko.B: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 웃사에게 크게 진노하셨고, 그가 궤에 손을 댔기 때문에 그를 치셨다. 그는 거기 하나님 앞에서 죽었다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 웃사에게 몹시 화가 나셨다. 웃사가 궤에 손을 댔기 때문에 그분께서 그를 치셨다. 웃사는 그 자리에서 하나님 앞에 쓰러져 죽었다.

pt.L: E a ira {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} se acendeu contra Uzá, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o feriu porque ele estendeu a sua mão sobre a arca; e ele morreu ali diante de Deus.
pt.B: Então a ira {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} se acendeu contra Uzá, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o feriu porque ele tinha estendido a mão para a arca. Ele morreu ali, diante de Deus.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} ficou muito irado com Uzá. Ele o feriu porque Uzá tinha posto a mão na arca, e Uzá morreu ali, diante de Deus.

am.L: {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}}ም ቁጣ በዖዛ ላይ ነደደ፤ እጁን በታቦቱ ላይ ስለ ዘረጋም መታው፤ በዚያም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሞተ።
am.B: በዚህ ጊዜ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቁጣ በዖዛ ላይ ነደደ፤ እጁን ወደ ታቦቱ ስለ ዘረጋም መታው። እርሱም በዚያ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሞተ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በዖዛ ላይ እጅግ ተቆጣ። ዖዛ እጁን በታቦቱ ላይ ስላደረገ መታው፤ ዖዛም በዚያ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሞተ።

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का क्रोध उज्जा पर भड़क उठा, और उन्होंने उसे मारा, क्योंकि उसने संदूक पर अपना हाथ बढ़ाया था; और वह वहीं परमेश्वर के सामने मर गया।
hi.B: तब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का क्रोध उज्जा पर भड़क उठा, और उन्होंने उसे मार गिराया, क्योंकि उसने संदूक की ओर अपना हाथ बढ़ाया था। वह वहीं परमेश्वर के सामने मर गया।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उज्जा पर बहुत क्रोधित हुए। उन्होंने उसे मार गिराया, क्योंकि उज्जा ने संदूक पर हाथ रखा था, और उज्जा वहीं परमेश्वर के सामने मर गया।

ru.L: И воспылал гнев {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} на Озу, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} поразил его за то, что он протянул свою руку на ковчег; и он умер там перед Богом.
ru.B: Тогда гнев {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} вспыхнул против Озы, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} поразил его за то, что тот протянул руку к ковчегу. Он умер там перед Богом.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} очень разгневался на Озу. Он поразил его за то, что Оза коснулся ковчега рукой, и Оза умер там перед Богом.

ja.L: すると{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の怒りがウザに対して燃え上がり、彼が箱に手を伸ばしたので、彼を打たれた。彼はそこで、神の前で死んだ。
ja.B: すると{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の怒りがウザに向かって激しく燃え上がり、彼が箱に手を伸ばしたので、彼を打たれた。彼はその場で、神の前で死んだ。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ウザにひどくお怒りになりました。ウザが箱に手を置いたので、その場でウザを打たれたのです。ウザは、そこで神の前で死にました。

uk.L: І запалав гнів {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНІЙ|Ягве}} на Уззу, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} уразив його за те, що той простяг свою руку на ковчег; і він помер там перед Богом.

uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дуже розгнівався на Уззу. Він уразив його за те, що Узза торкнувся рукою ковчега, і Узза помер там перед Богом.

decisions.choice: the differences from 2 Samuel 6:7
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 6:7 says that "God struck him there for the error, and he died there beside the ark of God". Chronicles says that the LORD struck him "because he put out his hand to the ark", and that he died "before God". The rare word in 2 Samuel probably names the same fault, and Chronicles states it plainly (see the note at 2 Samuel 6:7).

decisions.choice: the LORD's anger against Uzzah: the holiness of the ark
decisions.reason: The law warned that even the Levites who carried the holy things must not touch them, or they would die (Numbers 4:15), and many at Beth-shemesh had died for looking into the ark (1 Samuel 6:19). Uzzah meant to protect the ark, but it was holy, and it was being moved in a way the law did not allow (verse 7; 15:13). The text tells what happened and does not explain further.

decisions.choice: before God: in God's presence, beside the ark
decisions.reason: Uzzah died where he stood, beside the ark, which marked God's presence (verses 6, 8).

decisions.choice: was very angry
decisions.reason: As at 2 Samuel 6:7: Readable says "was very angry" for the picture of anger that "burned", and names Uzzah where "he" could be unclear.

decisions.choice: él lo hirió
decisions.reason: Spanish would leave the subject in the verb, but the English names it with a pronoun for God, so Spanish writes "él" to carry the deity_pronoun setting and to make clear that God, not Uzzah, struck.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span; "그분께서" with the honorific carries the respect
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun span has nothing to change in Korean (the Korean style guide, section 7).

decisions.choice: as 2 Samuel 6:7, with "porque estendeu a mão" and "diante de Deus"
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 6:7 in Portuguese ("a ira se acendeu", "ficou muito irado"), with the reason and the place Chronicles gives (m1): "porque ele estendeu a sua mão sobre a arca" for "por causa do erro", and "diante de Deus" for "junto da arca de Deus". The pronoun for the LORD takes the deity_pronoun setting where the English has it.

decisions.choice: 2 Samuel 6:7 with "እጁን በታቦቱ ላይ ስለ ዘረጋ" ("because he put out his hand on the ark") for "ስለ ስሕተቱ" ("for the error"), and "በእግዚአብሔር ፊት" ("before God") for "በእግዚአብሔር ታቦት አጠገብ"
decisions.reason: Chronicles gives the plain reason for the blow where Samuel has the rare word "error", and says Uzza died "before God" where Samuel says "beside the ark of God".

decisions.choice: The subject of "打たれた" is left unstated at every level; the respect form shows that the LORD struck him.
decisions.reason: The English has a deity pronoun here; Japanese uses no 彼 for God and keeps one divine name per level, as the English.

en.L: And David was angry because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had broken out [with] a breaking out against Uzzah; and he called that place Perez-uzzah, to this day.
en.B: David was angry because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had burst out against Uzzah, and he named that place Perez-uzzah, a name it still has to this day.
en.R: David was angry because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had burst out against Uzzah. So he named that place Perez-uzzah, which means "bursting out against Uzzah". It still has that name to this day.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 웃사를 쳐서 터뜨리셨기 때문에 다윗이 화가 났다. 그리고 그가 그곳을 베레스웃사라고 불렀는데, 오늘날까지 [그렇게 불린다].

ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 갑자기 웃사를 치셨기 때문에 다윗은 화가 났다. 그래서 그는 그곳을 '웃사를 치심'이라는 뜻으로 베레스웃사라고 불렀다. 그곳은 오늘날까지 그 이름으로 불린다.

pt.L: E Davi se irou porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha rompido [com] um rompimento contra Uzá; e chamou aquele lugar Perez-Uzá, até o dia de hoje.
pt.B: Davi ficou irado porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha rompido contra Uzá, e deu àquele lugar o nome de Perez-Uzá, nome que ele tem até hoje.

ja.L: ダビデは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がウザに対して怒りを破り出させられたので、怒った。そして彼はその場所をペレツ・ウザと呼んだ。今日に至るまで[そう呼ばれている]。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がウザに向かって怒りを爆発させられたので、ダビデは怒った。そして彼はその場所をペレツ・ウザと名づけた。その名は今日に至るまで残っている。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がウザに向かって怒りを爆発させられたので、ダビデは腹を立てました。それでダビデは、その場所をペレツ・ウザと名づけました。それは「ウザに向かって打ち破る」という意味です。その場所は、今でもその名で呼ばれています。

uk.L: І розгнівався Давид за те, що {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} вчинив пролом на Уззу; і назвав він те місце Перец-Узза, [як воно зветься] до цього дня.

uk.R: Давид розгнівався, бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} вибухнув гнівом на Уззу. Тож він назвав те місце Перец-Узза, що означає «вибух на Уззу». Воно так зветься й досі.

decisions.choice: David was angry
decisions.reason: As at 2 Samuel 6:8: the verb is the same "burn" used of the LORD's anger in verse 10, here without the word "anger". It may also mean that David was deeply upset (Jonah 4:1, 4). The text does not say whether his anger was against the LORD, against himself, or at what had happened.

decisions.choice: broke out ... Perez-uzzah: the same words as 2 Samuel 6:8
decisions.reason: This verse is the same as 2 Samuel 6:8 except for the spelling of Uzzah's name. The verb "break out" and the noun from it give the place its name, "breaking out against Uzzah". The people had planned to "spread out" with the same verb (verse 2); now the LORD breaks out against them. In Chronicles David names Baal-perazim, where the LORD broke out against his enemies, only after this (14:11), and he looks back on this day in 15:13: "the LORD our God broke out against us".

decisions.choice: to this day: the day the account was written
decisions.reason: As at 2 Samuel 6:8 and 4:41: the name was still in use when the account was written.

decisions.choice: which means "bursting out against Uzzah"
decisions.reason: As at 2 Samuel 6:8, Readable explains the meaning of the name, which a Hebrew reader would hear at once.

decisions.choice: "오늘날까지" at every level
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for the writer's own day; the verse is otherwise 2 Samuel 6:8 in Korean.

decisions.choice: rompido, rompimento; Perez-Uzá
decisions.reason: The verse is 2 Samuel 6:8 (m2), and so is the Portuguese at every level: "romper", "rompimento" and the name "Perez-Uzá", which keeps the link with Baal-Perazim (14:11).

decisions.choice: 2 Samuel 6:8 word for word at each level, with the place name "ፋሬስ ዖዛ"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as Samuel's, so the Amharic is the same.

en.L: And David feared God on that day, saying, "How shall I bring the ark of God to me?"
en.B: David was afraid of God that day, and he said, "How can I ever bring the ark of God to me?"
en.R: That day David was afraid of God. He said, "How can I ever bring the ark of God here to stay with me?"

es.L: Y temió David a Dios aquel día, y dijo: «¿Cómo he de traer a mí el arca de Dios?».
es.B: Aquel día David tuvo miedo de Dios, y dijo: «¿Cómo podré traer a mí el arca de Dios?».
es.R: Aquel día David tuvo miedo de Dios. Dijo: «¿Cómo podré traer aquí el arca de Dios para que se quede conmigo?».

fr.L: Et David eut peur de Dieu ce jour-là, en disant : « Comment ferai-je venir chez moi l’arche de Dieu ? »
fr.B: Ce jour-là, David eut peur de Dieu, et il dit : « Comment pourrais-je jamais faire venir chez moi l’arche de Dieu ? »
fr.R: Ce jour-là, David a eu peur de Dieu. Il a dit : « Comment pourrais-je faire venir l’arche de Dieu ici, pour qu’elle reste chez moi ? »

am.R: በዚያ ቀን ዳዊት እግዚአብሔርን ፈራ። እርሱም፦ «የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት እንዴት ወደዚህ አምጥቼ ከእኔ ዘንድ ላኖረው እችላለሁ?» አለ።

hi.L: और उस दिन दाऊद परमेश्वर से डर गया, और कहा, "मैं परमेश्वर के संदूक को अपने पास कैसे लाऊँ?"
hi.B: उस दिन दाऊद परमेश्वर से डर गया, और उसने कहा, "मैं परमेश्वर के संदूक को अपने पास कभी कैसे ला सकता हूँ?"
hi.R: उस दिन दाऊद परमेश्वर से डर गया। उसने कहा, "मैं परमेश्वर के संदूक को अपने पास रहने के लिए यहाँ कभी कैसे ला सकता हूँ?"

ru.L: И убоялся Давид Бога в тот день, говоря: «Как принесу я к себе ковчег Божий?»
ru.B: В тот день Давид испугался Бога и сказал: «Как же мне принести к себе ковчег Божий?»
ru.R: В тот день Давид испугался Бога. Он сказал: «Как же мне принести сюда ковчег Божий, чтобы он остался у меня?»

ja.L: その日、ダビデは神を恐れて言った。「どうして神の箱を、わたしのもとに運んで来ることができようか？」
ja.B: その日、ダビデは神を恐れて言った。「どうして神の箱を、わたしのところに迎えることができようか？」
ja.R: その日、ダビデは神がこわくなりました。ダビデは言いました。「どうして神の箱を、わたしのところに迎えて置くことなどできるだろうか？」

uk.L: І злякався Давид Бога того дня, кажучи: «Як я принесу до себе Божий ковчег?»
uk.B: Того дня Давид злякався Бога й сказав: «Як же я можу принести до себе Божий ковчег?»
uk.R: Того дня Давид злякався Бога. Він сказав: «Як я можу принести Божий ковчег сюди, щоб він був зі мною?»

decisions.choice: feared God: was afraid of him
decisions.reason: As at 2 Samuel 6:9: the verb can mean reverence or awe, but here, after Uzzah's death, it is plain fear of what God might do.

decisions.choice: the differences from 2 Samuel 6:9
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 6:9 says that David "feared the LORD" and asked, "How shall the ark of the LORD come to me?" Chronicles says "feared God" and "the ark of God", and makes David the one who acts: "How shall I bring the ark of God to me?" The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: How shall I bring ...?: a question of fear and doubt
decisions.reason: The question does not ask for a method. It means that David no longer dares to bring the ark into his own city (verse 13).

decisions.choice: here to stay with me
decisions.reason: As at 2 Samuel 6:9, Readable adds that the ark was to stay with David in his city.

decisions.choice: Mungu; sanduku la Mungu
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "God" where 2 Samuel 6:9 has "Yahweh", and David asks how he can bring the ark; the Swahili of Samuel changes only these words.

decisions.choice: Deus; trarei (L) / poderei trazer (B, R)
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 6:9 in Portuguese, with "Deus" for "o SENHOR" and David as the one who brings the ark, as Chronicles has it (m2).

decisions.choice: 2 Samuel 6:9 with "እግዚአብሔርን" (God) for "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}}" and "እንዴት አመጣለሁ?" ("how shall I bring?") for "እንዴት ይመጣል?" ("how shall it come?")
decisions.reason: Chronicles has Elohim for Samuel's YHWH twice in this verse, so the divine_name span is not used, and David asks how he can bring the ark rather than how it can come to him.

decisions.choice: "神" and "神の箱" where 2 Samuel 6:9 has the LORD; yare' "恐れる" (L, B), "こわくなりました" (R).
decisions.reason: Chronicles says God here; the divine-name span is used only where the Hebrew has YHWH.

source.text: וְלֹֽא־הֵסִ֨יר דָּוִ֧יד אֶת־הָאָר֛וֹן אֵלָ֖יו אֶל־עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַיַּטֵּ֕הוּ אֶל־בֵּ֥ית עֹבֵֽד־אֱדֹ֖ם הַגִּתִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And not turned aside David the ark to himself to [the] city of David, and he turned it aside to [the] house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.

en.L: And David did not move the ark to himself, into the city of David; and he turned it aside to the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.
en.B: So David did not take the ark into the city of David to be with him. Instead he turned aside and took it to the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.
en.R: So David did not take the ark home with him to the city of David. Instead, he had it taken off the road to the house of a man named Obed-Edom, who came from Gath.

es.L: Y no trasladó David el arca a sí, a la ciudad de David; y la desvió a la casa de Obed-edom el geteo.
es.B: Así que David no llevó el arca a la ciudad de David para tenerla consigo. En lugar de eso, se desvió y la llevó a la casa de Obed-edom el geteo.
es.R: Así que David no se llevó el arca a la ciudad de David. En cambio, hizo que la sacaran del camino y la llevaran a la casa de un hombre llamado Obed-edom, que era de Gat.

fr.L: Et David ne détourna pas l’arche vers lui, dans la cité de David ; et il la fit détourner vers la maison d’Obed-Édom le Guittite.
fr.B: David n’emmena donc pas l’arche chez lui, dans la cité de David. Il la fit plutôt détourner vers la maison d’Obed-Édom le Guittite.
fr.R: Alors David n’a pas emmené l’arche chez lui, dans la cité de David. À la place, il l’a fait conduire hors de la route, chez un homme appelé Obed-Édom, qui venait de Gath.

sw.L: Daudi hakulihamishia sanduku kwake, katika mji wa Daudi; akaligeuza [kwenda] nyumba ya Obed-edomu Mgiti.
sw.B: Basi Daudi hakulipeleka sanduku katika mji wa Daudi likae pamoja naye. Badala yake aligeuka akalipeleka nyumbani kwa Obed-edomu Mgiti.
sw.R: Basi Daudi hakulipeleka sanduku nyumbani kwake katika mji wa Daudi. Badala yake, aliagiza litolewe njiani lipelekwe nyumbani kwa mtu aitwaye Obed-edomu, aliyetoka Gathi.

vi.L: Đa-vít không dời hòm về với mình, vào thành Đa-vít; ông cho rẽ hòm sang nhà Ô-bết Ê-đôm người Gát.
vi.B: Vậy Đa-vít không đem hòm vào thành Đa-vít để ở với mình. Thay vào đó, ông cho đưa hòm rẽ sang nhà Ô-bết Ê-đôm người Gát.
vi.R: Vì vậy Đa-vít không đem hòm về thành Đa-vít với mình. Thay vào đó, ông cho người đưa hòm rẽ khỏi đường đến nhà một người tên là Ô-bết Ê-đôm, quê ở Gát.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 궤를 자기에게로, 다윗 성으로 옮기지 않았다. 그리고 그가 그것을 가드 사람 오벳에돔의 집으로 돌렸다.
ko.B: 그래서 다윗은 궤를 다윗 성 안 자기 곁으로 옮기지 않고, 방향을 돌려 가드 사람 오벳에돔의 집으로 가져갔다.
ko.R: 그래서 다윗은 궤를 다윗 성 자기 집으로 가져가지 않았다. 그 대신 그는 궤를 길에서 돌려 오벳에돔이라는 사람의 집으로 옮기게 했다. 오벳에돔은 가드 출신이었다.

pt.L: E Davi não levou a arca para junto de si, para a Cidade de Davi; e a desviou [para a] casa de Obede-Edom, o geteu.
pt.B: Por isso Davi não levou a arca para a Cidade de Davi, para junto de si. Em vez disso, desviou-se do caminho e a levou para a casa de Obede-Edom, o geteu.
pt.R: Por isso Davi não levou a arca para casa, para a Cidade de Davi. Em vez disso, mandou levá-la para fora do caminho, para a casa de um homem chamado Obede-Edom, que era de Gate.

am.L: ዳዊትም ታቦቱን ወደ እርሱ ወደ ዳዊት ከተማ አላመጣውም፤ ወደ ጌታዊው ወደ ዖቤድኤዶም ቤት አዞረው።
am.B: ስለዚህ ዳዊት ታቦቱ ከእርሱ ጋር እንዲሆን ወደ ዳዊት ከተማ አላመጣውም፤ ይልቁንም አቅጣጫውን ለውጦ ወደ ጌታዊው ወደ ዖቤድኤዶም ቤት ወሰደው።
am.R: ስለዚህ ዳዊት ታቦቱን ከእርሱ ጋር ወደ ዳዊት ከተማ አልወሰደውም። ይልቁንም ከመንገድ አስወጥቶ ከጌት ከተማ ወደ መጣው ዖቤድኤዶም ወደተባለው ሰው ቤት አስወሰደው።

hi.L: और दाऊद संदूक को अपने पास दाऊद के नगर में नहीं ले गया; और उसने उसे मोड़कर गित्ती ओबेद-एदोम के घर [पहुँचाया]।
hi.B: इसलिए दाऊद संदूक को अपने साथ रखने के लिए दाऊद के नगर में नहीं ले गया। इसके बदले वह मार्ग से हटकर उसे गित्ती ओबेद-एदोम के घर ले गया।
hi.R: इसलिए दाऊद संदूक को अपने साथ दाऊद के नगर में घर नहीं ले गया। इसके बदले उसने उसे मार्ग से हटाकर ओबेद-एदोम नाम के एक आदमी के घर पहुँचवा दिया, जो गत नगर का था।

ru.L: И не перенёс Давид ковчег к себе в город Давида, и отвёл его в дом Овед-Едома гефянина.
ru.B: Поэтому Давид не взял ковчег к себе в город Давида. Вместо этого он свернул и отнёс его в дом Овед-Едома гефянина.
ru.R: Поэтому Давид не взял ковчег к себе домой, в город Давида. Вместо этого он велел свернуть с дороги и отнести его в дом человека по имени Овед-Едом, который был родом из Гефа.

ja.L: ダビデは箱を自分のもとに、ダビデの町に移さず、それをガト人オベド・エドムの家にそらせた。
ja.B: そこでダビデは、箱を自分のもとに、ダビデの町に移そうとはしなかった。そして道をそれて、それをガト人オベド・エドムの家に運ばせた。
ja.R: それでダビデは、箱を自分の住むダビデの町に運ぶのをやめました。そして道からそれて、ガトから来たオベド・エドムという人の家に運ばせました。

uk.L: І не переніс Давид ковчега до себе, до міста Давидового, а звернув його до дому Овед-Едома гітянина.
uk.B: Тож Давид не взяв ковчега до себе в місто Давида. Натомість він звернув і відніс його до дому Овед-Едома гітянина.
uk.R: Тож Давид не взяв ковчега додому, до міста Давида. Натомість він звелів звернути з дороги й віднести його до дому чоловіка на імʼя Овед-Едом, родом з Гату.

decisions.choice: the differences from 2 Samuel 6:10
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 6:10 says that David "was not willing" to move "the ark of the LORD" to himself, and that "David" turned it aside. Chronicles says simply that he did not move "the ark", and has "he" in the second clause. The story is the same.

decisions.choice: the city of David: the stronghold of Zion
decisions.reason: David had captured the stronghold of Zion and it was called the city of David (11:5, 7). It was the oldest part of Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: Obed-Edom the Gittite: a man from a town called Gath
decisions.reason: "Gittite" means a man from Gath. This could be the Philistine city, since David had men from there among his followers (2 Samuel 15:18-19). It could also be Gath-rimmon, a town given to the Levites (Joshua 21:24-25), and Chronicles names an Obed-Edom among the Levite gatekeepers and musicians who served the ark (15:18, 24; 16:38; 26:4). The text here does not say which.

decisions.choice: had it taken off the road; who came from Gath
decisions.reason: As at 2 Samuel 6:10, Readable says plainly what "turned it aside" and "Gittite" mean.

decisions.choice: não levou (for "não quis levar"); Obede-Edom, o geteu
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 6:10 in Portuguese, with "não levou" where Samuel has "não quis levar", "a arca" without "do SENHOR", and no second "Davi" (m1). "Obede-Edom, o geteu" as 2 Samuel.

decisions.choice: 2 Samuel 6:10 with "ታቦቱን ... አላመጣውም" ("did not bring the ark") for "{{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ታቦት ... ያመጣው ዘንድ አልፈቀደም" ("was not willing to bring the ark of the LORD")
decisions.reason: Chronicles says "the ark" and "David did not move it" where Samuel says "the ark of Yahweh" and "David was not willing"; Obed-Edom the Gittite keeps "ጌታዊው ዖቤድኤዶም".

source.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב֩ אֲר֨וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים עִם־בֵּ֨ית עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם בְּבֵית֖וֹ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וַיְבָ֧רֶךְ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־בֵּ֥ית עֹבֵֽד־אֱדֹ֖ם וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לֽוֹ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And remained [the] ark of the God with [the] household of Obed-Edom in his house three months; and blessed Yahweh [the] household of Obed-Edom and all that [was] to him.

en.L: And the ark of God remained with the household of Obed-Edom in his house three months, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} blessed the household of Obed-Edom and all that [was] his.
en.B: The ark of God stayed for three months with the household of Obed-Edom in his house, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} blessed Obed-Edom's household and everything he had.
en.R: The ark of God stayed with Obed-Edom's family in his house for three months. And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} blessed Obed-Edom's family and everything he owned.

es.L: Y permaneció el arca de Dios con la familia de Obed-edom, en su casa, tres meses; y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} bendijo a la familia de Obed-edom y todo lo que [era] suyo.
es.B: El arca de Dios se quedó tres meses con la familia de Obed-edom, en su casa, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} bendijo a la familia de Obed-edom y todo lo que tenía.
es.R: El arca de Dios se quedó con la familia de Obed-edom, en su casa, durante tres meses. Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} bendijo a la familia de Obed-edom y todo lo que tenía.

fr.L: Et l’arche de Dieu demeura avec la maison d’Obed-Édom, dans sa maison, trois mois ; et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} bénit la maison d’Obed-Édom et tout ce qui [était] à lui.
fr.B: L’arche de Dieu resta trois mois auprès de la famille d’Obed-Édom, dans sa maison, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} bénit la famille d’Obed-Édom et tout ce qui lui appartenait.
fr.R: L’arche de Dieu est restée trois mois chez Obed-Édom, avec sa famille. Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a béni la famille d’Obed-Édom et tout ce qu’il possédait.

sw.L: Sanduku la Mungu likakaa pamoja na watu wa nyumbani mwa Obed-edomu katika nyumba yake miezi mitatu, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawabariki watu wa nyumbani mwa Obed-edomu na vyote [vilivyokuwa] vyake.
sw.B: Sanduku la Mungu lilikaa kwa miezi mitatu pamoja na watu wa nyumbani mwa Obed-edomu katika nyumba yake, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawabariki watu wa nyumbani mwa Obed-edomu na kila kitu alichokuwa nacho.
sw.R: Sanduku la Mungu lilikaa kwa miezi mitatu pamoja na jamaa ya Obed-edomu nyumbani kwake. Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaibariki jamaa ya Obed-edomu na kila kitu alichokuwa nacho.

vi.L: Hòm của Đức Chúa Trời ở với gia đình Ô-bết Ê-đôm trong nhà ông ba tháng, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban phước cho gia đình Ô-bết Ê-đôm cùng mọi vật thuộc về ông.
vi.B: Hòm của Đức Chúa Trời ở lại với gia đình Ô-bết Ê-đôm trong nhà ông ba tháng, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban phước cho gia đình Ô-bết Ê-đôm cùng mọi thứ ông có.
vi.R: Hòm của Đức Chúa Trời ở với gia đình Ô-bết Ê-đôm trong nhà ông ba tháng. Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban phước cho gia đình Ô-bết Ê-đôm cùng mọi thứ ông sở hữu.

ko.L: 그리고 하나님의 궤가 오벳에돔의 집안과 함께 그의 집에 석 달 동안 머물렀다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 오벳에돔의 집안과 그에게 [속한] 모든 것에 복을 주셨다.
ko.B: 하나님의 궤는 오벳에돔의 집에서 그의 가족과 함께 석 달 동안 머물렀고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 오벳에돔의 집안과 그의 모든 소유에 복을 주셨다.
ko.R: 하나님의 궤는 오벳에돔의 집에서 그의 가족과 함께 석 달 동안 있었다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 오벳에돔의 가족과 그가 가진 모든 것에 복을 주셨다.

pt.L: E a arca de Deus ficou com a família de Obede-Edom, na casa dele, três meses; e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} abençoou a família de Obede-Edom e tudo o que [era] dele.
pt.B: A arca de Deus ficou três meses com a família de Obede-Edom, na casa dele, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} abençoou a família de Obede-Edom e tudo o que ele tinha.
pt.R: A arca de Deus ficou com a família de Obede-Edom, na casa dele, durante três meses. E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} abençoou a família de Obede-Edom e tudo o que ele possuía.

ru.L: И оставался ковчег Божий у семьи Овед-Едома, в его доме, три месяца, и благословил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} дом Овед-Едома и всё, что [было] у него.
ru.B: Ковчег Божий пробыл у семьи Овед-Едома в его доме три месяца, и {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} благословил семью Овед-Едома и всё, что у него было.
ru.R: Ковчег Божий оставался у семьи Овед-Едома в его доме три месяца. И {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} благословил семью Овед-Едома и всё, что ему принадлежало.

ja.L: そして神の箱は、オベド・エドムの家族と共に、彼の家に三か月とどまった。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はオベド・エドムの家族と、彼のものすべてを祝福された。
ja.B: 神の箱は、オベド・エドムの家族のもとに、その家に三か月とどまった。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はオベド・エドムの家族と、その持ち物すべてを祝福された。
ja.R: 神の箱は、オベド・エドムの家族のところに、三か月の間置かれていました。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、オベド・エドムの家族と、その持ち物すべてを祝福されました。

uk.L: І залишився Божий ковчег з родиною Овед-Едома в його домі три місяці; і {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} благословив родину Овед-Едома і все, що [було] в нього.
uk.B: Божий ковчег пробув три місяці з родиною Овед-Едома в його домі, і {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} благословив родину Овед-Едома і все, що він мав.
uk.R: Божий ковчег три місяці стояв у домі Овед-Едома, з його родиною. І {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} благословив родину Овед-Едома і все, що він мав.

decisions.choice: the differences from 2 Samuel 6:11
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 6:11 says that "the ark of the LORD remained at the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite" and that the LORD "blessed Obed-Edom and all his household". Chronicles says that "the ark of God remained with the household of Obed-Edom in his house", making clear that the ark stayed inside his home with his family, and that the LORD "blessed the household of Obed-Edom and all that he had", words close to those reported to David in 2 Samuel 6:12. In Chronicles the three months frame chapter 14, before the ark is brought up in chapter 15.

decisions.choice: household ... house: the family, then the building
decisions.reason: The same word is used twice with two senses: first the household, his family and those who lived under his care, and then his house, the building where the ark stayed.

decisions.choice: the LORD blessed Obed-Edom's household: the ark brings blessing as well as judgment
decisions.reason: The same ark that brought death to Uzzah brought good to the household that kept it. Chronicles later lists the many sons God gave Obed-Edom, "for God had blessed him" (26:4-5).

decisions.choice: family; everything he owned
decisions.reason: Readable says "family" for "household" and "everything he owned" for "all that was his".

decisions.choice: a família ... na casa dele
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew word is first the household and then the building (m2): Portuguese says "a família" and "a casa", at every level, where 2 Samuel 6:11 in Portuguese has "a casa de Obede-Edom" and "toda a sua família".

decisions.choice: 2 Samuel 6:11 with "የእግዚአብሔር ታቦት" ("the ark of God") for "the ark of the LORD", "ከዖቤድኤዶም ቤተሰብ ጋር በቤቱ" ("with the household of Obed-Edom in his house"), and "ያለውን ሁሉ" ("all that he had") as in 2 Samuel 6:12
decisions.reason: Chronicles words the stay and the blessing as Samuel reports it in the next verse (6:12), so that wording is used.
